title: Static Heavy-Chest Paired-Tusk Walrus
description: One newly authored whole stylised walrus-like animal in a low fixed resting pose. A heavy tall forechest and short broad blunt head merge into a deep tapering rear body, with two thick lateral front flippers and two separately splayed posterior flippers rather than a whale tail. Broad paired muzzle pads, a small dark nose, low lateral eyes and two long curved downward tusks form the face. Every full body section and flipper/tusk/muzzle path is new, not a copied seal with tusks added, a pig torso with hooves removed or a whale tail split. One opaque static animal prop, zero scenes; finite low belly datum for placement only. No exact species or scientific anatomy, whisker simulation, breathing, motion, tusk function, handling, danger, rig, animation or interaction claim.
